identity.name: G-Shock Full Metal 5000

case.bezel: none — DLC-coated screw-lock caseback, integrated square case

identity.one_liner: The first G-Shock square built from solid stainless steel instead of resin, adding Bluetooth sync and solar charging to the 1983 case shape.

provenance_events.description: The GMW-B5000 brings the iconic 5600 silhouette to a full-metal case — the first all-metal square G-Shock. The 2018 launch becomes the most-cited "premium G-Shock" of the 2010s-2020s.

narrative.story: The GMW-B5000D-1 is the first G-Shock square made entirely from stainless steel rather than a resin-clad case, applying full-metal construction to the silhouette of the original 1983 DW-5000C. Casio released it in Japan in April 2018 and in the US that May at $500, adding Bluetooth phone sync and Tough Solar charging to a shape that had run in resin form for 35 years. It sits above the resin DW-5600 and steel GW-5000U as the entry point into G-Shock's metal-square lineup, below the titanium MRG-B5000.
narrative.collector_notes: The silver GMW-B5000D-1 is the standard full-metal square; a gold IP-plated GMW-B5000TFG-9 and later colorway variants exist at higher price points but the silver reference is what collectors mean by 'the full metal square' by default.
